rows.grounds: fused sandhi form murāri+ūrdhva+saṃyuktaṃ; analyzed as given

items.question: What is declared as the support of that joined with Murāri above?
premises: support is declared for that entity
the entity is joined with Murāri above
items.inference: The support of the entity joined with Murāri above is declared.
uncertainties: exact referent of tasya is not explicit in this verse
internal sandhi of murāricordhvasaṃyuktaṃ is analyzed without splitting the token
items.plain_english: Its support, joined with Murāri above, is declared.
